entities.name: Zahid
entities.description: Blue-skinned djinn of Dominaria, formerly bound to a lamp, later forced to serve the Cabal imposter Liliana.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker; the Cabal imposter who used Zahid's sapphire choker, and the real Liliana who subdued him.

entities.name: Caligo
entities.description: Place whose people were enslaved with Zahid's help.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Person who broke the amulet releasing Zahid.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact used by the real Liliana to subdue Zahid.

events.summary: Zahid was bound to the sapphire placed in a choker used by the imposter Liliana, who forced him to do her bidding.
